content: When Microsoft announced its latest round of Xbox price bumps in June, it only gave US pricing. Now we know the pricing increases for the EU and UK, and they’re dramatic. Depending on the model, Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is going up by over 30 percent from £499.99 / €599.99 to £669.99 / €799.99. The 512GB Xbox Series S is getting a price increase of over 43 percent, jumping from £299.99 / €349.99 to £429.99 / €499.99. While other consoles have received price bumps as RAM and storage prices skyrocket due to demand from the AI industry, none have been quite as dramatic as Microsoft’s. This is the third round of price increases since May of 2025, with the highest-end model now costing $300 more than its launch price of $499.99 in 2020. The 2TB model is also being retired in the face of the storage crunch. Here’s the full list of price changes: > 512GB Xbox Series S was €349.99 / £299.99, now €499.99 / £429.99 > 1TB Xbox Series S was €399.99 / £349.99, now €599.99 / £519.99 > 1TB Xbox Series X Digital was €549.99 / £449.99, now €749.99 / £619.99 > 1TB Xbox Series X Disc was €599.99 / £499.99, now €799.99 / £669.99

chineseContent: 当微软在 6 月份宣布最新一轮 Xbox 价格上涨时，它只给出了美国定价。现在我们知道欧盟和英国的价格上涨，而且幅度很大。根据型号的不同，Xbox 价格上涨最多 200 欧元或 170 英镑。带光驱的 1TB Xbox Series X 价格上涨超过 30%，从 499.99 英镑/599.99 欧元涨至 669.99 英镑/799.99 欧元。 512GB Xbox Series S 的价格上涨超过 43%，从 299.99 英镑/349.99 欧元跃升至 429.99 英镑/499.99 欧元。虽然其他游戏机的价格因人工智能行业的需求而导致 RAM 和存储价格飙升，但没有一个像微软那样引人注目。这是自 2025 年 5 月以来的第三轮涨价，目前最高端型号的价格比 2020 年 499.99 美元的上市价格高出了 300 美元。面对存储紧缩，2TB 型号也即将退役。以下是价格变动的完整列表： > 512GB Xbox Series S 原价 349.99 欧元 / 299.99 英镑，现价 499.99 / 429.99 英镑 > 1TB Xbox Series S 原价 399.99 欧元 / 349.99 欧元，现价 599.99 / 519.99 英镑 > 1TB Xbox Series X Digital 原价 549.99 / 449.99 英镑，现在 €749.99 / £619.99 > 1TB Xbox Series X 光盘原价 €599.99 / £499.99，现在 €799.99 / £669.99
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
